THE SCOPE

Project deliverables

01

Manuscript upgrade

Update the existing manuscript for relevance, engagement, and conversion. Revise company references and approved examples, preserve the story format, and strengthen the calls to action.

02

Book refresh

Modernize the cover, refresh the print interior, and add guided chapter questions and QR codes. Create the new ebook file, proofread and check the files, and fully set up on Storybase.

03

Audiobook

Prepare the narration script for David Ortiz to record at Works24. Edit the recording for retakes and goofs, and master the audio. Create square audiobook version of the cover. Studio recording fees are separate—our audio engineer, Thomas Harkin, will bill for his own time.

04

Book companion

Build a “legacy assessment” tool that gives readers meaningful insight and a next toward your team, plus eight short chapter reflection/generator experiences that keep readers coming back. Connect book access, contact capture, free audio and ebook access, and call booking.

05

Email and text
follow-up

Write and configure an access-triggered contact sequence, with conversion-focused emails and opt-in texts, to help readers engage with the book, use the tools, and book a conversation.
